package autochess

import "sort"

// Apply 在事务局部副本执行；失败不写 DAO。Epoch 来自鉴权接管，Seq 永久递增。
func (s *State) Apply(id int64, c Command, now int64) (Receipt, bool, error) {
	i := s.Index(id)
	if i < 0 || c.Seq == 0 {
		return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
	}
	p := &s.Seats[i]
	if c.Epoch != p.Epoch {
		return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
	}
	if c.Seq <= uint64(len(p.Receipts)) {
		r := p.Receipts[c.Seq-1]
		if r.Command != c {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		return r, false, nil
	}
	if c.Seq != uint64(len(p.Receipts)+1) || len(p.Receipts) >= LedgerLimit || s.Phase != "prep" || p.HP == 0 || p.Ready || !p.Connected || c.Round != s.Round || now < s.LastAt || now >= s.Deadline {
		return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
	}
	switch c.Kind {
	case "buy":
		if c.A < 0 || c.A >= 3 || c.B != 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		k := p.Shop[c.A]
		if k == 0 || p.Gold < s.Rules.Units[k-1].Cost {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		slot := -1
		for j := 3; j < 9; j++ {
			if p.Units[j].Copies == 0 {
				slot = j
				break
			}
		}
		if slot < 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		p.Units[slot] = Unit{k, 1}
		p.Shop[c.A] = 0
		p.Gold -= s.Rules.Units[k-1].Cost
		p.merge()
	case "sell":
		if c.A < 0 || c.A >= 9 || c.B != 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		u := p.Units[c.A]
		if u.Copies == 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		p.Units[c.A] = Unit{}
		s.Pool[u.Kind-1] += u.Copies
		p.Gold += u.Copies * s.Rules.Units[u.Kind-1].Cost
	case "move":
		if c.A < 0 || c.A >= 9 || c.B < 0 || c.B >= 9 || c.A == c.B || p.Units[c.A].Copies == 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		p.Units[c.A], p.Units[c.B] = p.Units[c.B], p.Units[c.A]
		n := 0
		for _, u := range p.Units[:3] {
			if u.Copies > 0 {
				n++
			}
		}
		if n > p.Level {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
	case "refresh":
		if c.A != 0 || c.B != 0 || p.Gold < 2 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		p.Gold -= 2
		s.refresh(i)
	case "xp":
		if c.A != 0 || c.B != 0 || p.Gold < 4 || p.Level >= 3 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		p.Gold -= 4
		p.XP += 2
		if p.XP >= 4 {
			p.XP -= 4
			p.Level++
		}
	case "lock":
		if c.A != 0 || c.B != 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		p.Locked = !p.Locked
	case "ready":
		if c.A != 0 || c.B != 0 {
			return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
		}
		p.Ready = true
	default:
		return Receipt{}, false, ErrRule
	}
	s.LastAt = now
	all := true
	for _, q := range s.Seats {
		if q.HP > 0 && !q.Ready {
			all = false
		}
	}
	if all {
		s.startBattle(now)
	}
	r := Receipt{c, p.Gold, s.Round, s.Phase}
	p.Receipts = append(p.Receipts, r)
	return r, true, s.Validate()
}

// 接管票由可信入口递增发放；同票重试不重复变更，旧连接断线不能踢掉新连接。
func (s *State) Connect(id int64, ticket uint64, connected bool) error {
	i := s.Index(id)
	if i < 0 || ticket == 0 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	p := &s.Seats[i]
	if connected {
		if ticket < p.Epoch {
			return ErrRule
		}
		if ticket == p.Epoch {
			if !p.Connected {
				return ErrRule
			}
			return nil
		}
		p.Epoch = ticket
		p.Connected = true
	} else {
		if ticket != p.Epoch {
			return ErrRule
		}
		p.Connected = false
	}
	return nil
}

// 冷加载只推进一个阶段，下一期限从当前服务端时间起算，不追赶一小时的全部战斗。
func (s *State) Advance(now int64) error {
	if s.Phase == "done" || now < s.Deadline || now >= MaxTime {
		return ErrRule
	}
	s.LastAt = now
	if s.Phase == "prep" {
		s.startBattle(now)
	} else {
		s.settle(now)
	}
	return s.Validate()
}
func (s *State) startBattle(now int64) {
	s.Phase = "battle"
	s.Deadline = now + s.Rules.BattleMillis
	s.Fights = nil
	alive := []int{}
	for i, p := range s.Seats {
		if p.HP > 0 {
			alive = append(alive, i)
		}
	}
	if len(alive) > 1 {
		shift := (s.Round - 1) % len(alive)
		alive = append(alive[shift:], alive[:shift]...)
	}
	for j := 0; j < len(alive); j += 2 {
		a := alive[j]
		f := Fight{A: a, B: -1, Winner: a}
		copy(f.Boards[0][:], s.Seats[a].Units[:3])
		if j+1 < len(alive) {
			f.B = alive[j+1]
			copy(f.Boards[1][:], s.Seats[f.B].Units[:3])
			f.Winner, f.Damage = Resolve(s.Rules, f)
		}
		s.Fights = append(s.Fights, f)
	}
}

// 位置从前排到后排；同 tick 同时攻击，最多 32 tick，余血相同时为平局。纯函数可从冻结编队重放。
func Resolve(r Rules, f Fight) (int, int) {
	hp := [2][3]int{}
	attack := [2][3]int{}
	for side, b := range f.Boards {
		for j, u := range b {
			if u.Copies > 0 {
				star := 1
				if u.Copies == 3 {
					star = 2
				} else if u.Copies == 9 {
					star = 3
				}
				hp[side][j] = r.Units[u.Kind-1].HP * star
				attack[side][j] = r.Units[u.Kind-1].Attack * star
			}
		}
	}
	for tick := 0; tick < 32; tick++ {
		first := [2]int{-1, -1}
		damage := [2]int{}
		for side := range hp {
			for j, v := range hp[side] {
				if v > 0 {
					if first[side] < 0 {
						first[side] = j
					}
					damage[side] += attack[side][j]
				}
			}
		}
		if first[0] < 0 || first[1] < 0 {
			break
		}
		hp[0][first[0]] -= damage[1]
		hp[1][first[1]] -= damage[0]
	}
	sum := [2]int{}
	for side := range hp {
		for _, v := range hp[side] {
			if v > 0 {
				sum[side] += v
			}
		}
	}
	if sum[0] == sum[1] {
		return -1, 1
	}
	if sum[0] > sum[1] {
		return f.A, 3
	}
	return f.B, 3
}
func (s *State) settle(now int64) {
	for _, f := range s.Fights {
		if f.B < 0 {
			continue
		}
		for _, i := range []int{f.A, f.B} {
			if i != f.Winner {
				s.Seats[i].HP = max(0, s.Seats[i].HP-f.Damage)
			}
		}
	}
	alive := []int{}
	dead := []int{}
	remaining := 0
	for i, p := range s.Seats {
		if p.Rank == 0 {
			remaining++
			if p.HP == 0 {
				dead = append(dead, i)
			} else {
				alive = append(alive, i)
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Sort(sort.Reverse(sort.IntSlice(dead)))
	for _, i := range dead {
		s.Seats[i].Rank = remaining
		remaining--
		s.release(i)
	}
	if len(alive) <= 1 || s.Round == s.Rules.MaxRounds {
		sort.Slice(alive, func(i, j int) bool {
			a, b := alive[i], alive[j]
			if s.Seats[a].HP == s.Seats[b].HP {
				return a < b
			}
			return s.Seats[a].HP > s.Seats[b].HP
		})
		for rank, i := range alive {
			s.Seats[i].Rank = rank + 1
		}
		s.Phase = "done"
		s.Deadline = 0
		return
	}
	s.Round++
	s.Phase = "prep"
	s.Deadline = now + s.Rules.PrepMillis
	for _, i := range alive {
		p := &s.Seats[i]
		p.Ready = false
		p.Gold += 5 + min(5, p.Gold/10)
		if !p.Locked {
			s.refresh(i)
		}
	}
}
